integrity: For every zero vertex v of CP_n, the open-neighborhood label sum is exactly total weight minus the label of its unique nonneighbor. Hence at weight at least four the defense condition is automatic, while totality is exactly the requirement that positive support meet at least two partner pairs. Subtracting labelings supported in at most one pair leaves only two low-weight invalid families: two cross-pair ones at weight two, and a cross-pair labels two-plus-one pattern at weight three. This yields the full polynomial, and exhaustive enumeration through n=5 matches every coefficient.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats cocktail party graphs, equivalently complete multipartite graphs with every part of size two, rather than arbitrary complete multipartite graphs.
The scalar total Roman {2}-domination number for complete multipartite graphs appears in prior work and is not an originality basis.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from two through five and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed all-function enumerator may exist.
title: Weight enumerator of total Roman \(\{2\}\)-dominating functions on cocktail party graphs
